title: FDA Approval Catalyst Pipeline Input
description: For each ticker, correlate recent FDA approvals and clearances with insider open-market buying. Pay per scored event.

tickers.title: Tickers
tickers.description: Stock tickers to scan. Each is resolved to its company name via the SEC company map, then matched against openFDA sponsor/applicant records.

eventTypes.title: FDA event types
eventTypes.description: Which openFDA event types to include. Drug approvals (NDA/BLA), device PMA approvals, and 510(k) clearances.

maxAgeDays.title: FDA lookback (days)
maxAgeDays.description: How far back to pull FDA decisions. Default 120 days catches the recent catalyst window.

insiderWindowDays.title: Insider window (days)
insiderWindowDays.description: Days on each side of an FDA decision date to count insider open-market buys and sells.

includeInsider.title: Include insider transactions
includeInsider.description: Pull SEC Form 4 open-market buys and sells and correlate them with each FDA event. Turn off to score FDA events alone.

minScore.title: Minimum score
minScore.description: Drop events scoring below this 0 to 100 convergence score. Zero returns every event in range.

maxEventsPerCompany.title: Max events per company
maxEventsPerCompany.description: Cap FDA events pulled per company before scoring.

maxEventsTotal.title: Max events total
maxEventsTotal.description: Cap total FDA events scored across all tickers in one run.

userAgent.title: User-Agent (with email)
userAgent.description: SEC EDGAR requires a User-Agent containing a contact email. Example: 'yourname research@yourdomain.com'. Leave blank to use a default.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify proxy, passed through to the Form 4 child. openFDA and the EDGAR ticker map are called directly and do not need a proxy.
